product_summary: Maize (corn) refining company, plant at Dondaicha, Dist. Dhule (MS), capacity 750 MTS/day maize refining. Product lines per own website (universalstarch.com/products), grouped by the company itself into food / pharma / paper / textile / pregel / industrial / nutraceuticals: (1) FOOD: Maize Starch, Dextrose Monohydrate, Liquid Glucose. (2) PHARMA: Maize Starch IP/BP/USP/EP, Liquid Glucose (SO2 Free), Dextrose Monohydrate IP/BP, Dextrose Anhydrous IP/BP/USP, Dextrose Syrup. (3) PAPER: Pepsize 200 (Oxidised), Unisol B 160, Unicat S 25, Unipap SS (Spray), Unilose A, Unilose E, Utexlose 40, Utexlose 90, Unitex B, Unitex LV 500, Unitex SS 50, Unidenim. (4) TEXTILE: same size/cationic-starch family (Unilose, Utexlose, Unitex). (5) PREGEL: Unigel 160, Unigel 270 BP/USP, Unigel 500. (6) INDUSTRIAL: Maize Starch Powder, White Dextrine, Dextrose Anhydrous IP. (7) NUTRACEUTICALS: Maize Starch IP, Unigel 270 BP/USP, Low Iodine Starch. Also named on the About page: starch, DMH, DAH, LG and pregel starches; first Indian supplier to ship liquid glucose by tanker.
comment: HS mapping (source: https://www.universalstarch.com/products and https://www.universalstarch.com/ — own catalogue, no customs line available to me in this task): native maize/corn starch (food and IP/BP/USP/EP pharma grades) -> 110812; pregelatinised starches Unigel 160/270/500 -> 110812 (pregelatinised, i.e. pre-cooked/modified by physical treatment; if chemically modified it would fall to 350510); dextrose monohydrate and dextrose anhydrous IP/BP/USP -> 170230; liquid glucose / glucose syrup (incl. SO2-free) and dextrose syrup -> 170240; white dextrine -> 350510; oxidised starch Pepsize 200 and the paper/textile size & cationic starch family (Unisol, Unicat, Unipap, Unilose, Utexlose, Unitex, Unidenim) -> 350510 (modified starches) or 380910 (finishing agents with amylaceous base for paper/textile) depending on the actual preparation; low-iodine starch -> 110812. VERDICT: declared 350510 is only PARTIALLY correct. It covers the modified/oxidised starches and dextrine, but the company's core volume — native maize starch (110812) and glucose/dextrose syrups (170230/170240) — is not represented by the single declared code. Per project rule 3 the company is NOT rejected for this: it stays in the base and the code is corrected to the actual range above; verdict accepted_hs_corrected. INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is too narrow — the company is a maize-refining / starch-and-glucose chemical processor whose main declared end-markets are pharmaceuticals (excipient supplier, OPPI 'Best Vendor' excipient 1998-99), paper and textile sizing, plus food. Correct framing: agro-processing / starch & glucose derivatives (chemical-adjacent), not FMCG. TRADER SIGNS: none — own factory at Rawal Industrial Estate, Dondaicha, own R&D/engineering/production teams, captive co-gen and wind power; role = manufacturer. PRODUCT LINES MISSING FROM THE DECLARATION: native maize starch, dextrose monohydrate/anhydrous, liquid glucose and dextrose syrup, pregelatinised starches, paper/textile sizing and cationic starch specialties, low-iodine starch. All of the above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — taken from the company's own website/catalogue only; I did not verify any of it against a customs line, and per the task scope I did not research registries, revenue or shipment volumes.
